title: Everything about this is too overwhelming
body:
For an app/service that is marketed as a tool to help you conquer ADHD and procrastination, this failed miserably - for me, anyway. 

The entire on-boarding and incoheren user interface instilled heretofore unseen levels of anxiety. I doubt that anybody involved with the development of this app has been anywhere near a study about the root-cause of procrastination, and its links to ADHD and ASD. 

When I saw how much time would be needed to figure out the basic functionality in Fabulous, my brain just shut down. It made my problems worse. Whoever ever made the user interface has no understanding of the impact that clutter has on people who want to try overcome their perpetual anxiety. 

And when I went to cancel my sub, it became clear what this really is: a toxic cashgrab by techbros. 

Five screens of nagging counteroffers and FUD messaging. Piss off. Let me cancel and have some peace. 

Deleting this is the first step I’m taking to declutter and simplify my life.

title: Total scam
body:
It’s a shame you can’t give ‘minus’ stars!!! Signed up to a 14 day trial (paid) via Facebook. (I’m beginning to think that anything advertised on FB is a scam by definition). Despite my ticking the ‘not interested’ box - twice -  it attempted to take an extra €49 for the three month sub out of my account - twice!! Luckily I signed up with Revolut who immediately stopped the attempted thefts and cancelled my card. The only emails I got from them were variations on the sign up scam - no promised plan. It’s beautifully presented and very plausible and I’m usually sceptical about these things but they suckered me. Anyway, Revolut is on the case! Avoid like the plague!!!
UPDATE:
I’ve read through all the reviews here (should have done that before I signed up). I’ve actually started wondering if the positive ones are fake. ALL of the negative ones are about money being taken without permission, and the response from the developer is always the same….’we’re concerned’ and ‘please check our policy on refunds’ etc. and this response has been used in response to every complaint for the last SIX years!!!! I’m actually going to see if there’s anyway of legally getting the app removed permanently from App stores. DO NOT TRUST IT!!!

body:

I am rooting for the team behind the app and recommending it to anyone I know. The only caveat is that it’s hard to recommend a friend to a paying app when they don’t see the value in it yet so I’d suggest a better freemium product before joining the paid version. 
The pricing is slightly complicated to understand- I’m not sure if the sphere series is different to premium or not? Maybe clarify the difference or how they interact. 
Really excellent design and human approach with so much emotional intelligence packed in. I’m really proud to be a user! I’ll sign up for lifetime when I can.
author: joannapedrina

title: Feels like a scam
body:
7 day free trial followed by a €60 per year subscription. The subscription is signed up to automatically by using the free 7 day trial. Price is not displayed until you enter all your sign up data. 

The people taking the trial are your future customers. If they want your product they’ll pay. If they don’t they won’t. Making it an opt out or you’ll be charged service is a scam to try get some extra cash from people who forget to cancel if they didn’t like the product. 

Bad first impression - app deleted 

Also the ‘click this button if your don’t want to receive content’ text is I think illegal in Europe. You should be opted out initially and then select to button only to accept. 

Overall initial image of this app - developers grabbing money and data anyway they can without actually caring for their customers.

title: Poor customer service
body:
I signed up for the ‘free’ trial only to gave to commit to the years subscription at a cost of €48.99. I did not find the app engaging at all. And there was nothing more unique than if I had set up some manual reminders for myself. Very underwhelming. 
I tried to get my money back. Radio silence. I was in touch with someone but they have not responded to my email requests for a refund. I’m going to pursue this complaint through Apple.

Update: 6 months after I posted this, I got a response from not-so-‘fabulous’ with an email address to write to. I did this over 6 months ago and to no avail. Why send a generic response to my review? Unbelievably poor customer service and interest in their satisfaction. Failure is certain for this app.
